title: SUBMIT TO GOD
RESIST THE ENEMY
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: dark silhouette of an ancient watchtower against a starry sky
flickering candlelight in a dark stone sanctuary
deep blue twilight over a calm vast mountain lake
glowing embers in a stone fireplace at night
moonlit path through a quiet forest
infinite starry night sky over a desert horizon

scenes.a: The heavy thought cycling in your mind right now is not yours to carry alone tonight.
James 4:7 says, Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Father, we come before you in this stillness to surrender every fear that has taken root.
We yield our hearts, our confusion, and our battles into your capable and ever-loving hands now.
Give us the courage to resist every lie and every shadow that dares to linger here.
Let your peace reign supreme as we rest, knowing you are our protector in the darkness.
